transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the greenlight meeting today regarding the independent concert documentary license for the international airline's passenger-entertainment system. The buyer's draft package proposes a worldwide, twelve-month, non-exclusive license using the documentary's current picture and delivery master. Before I can sign off, I need each of you — rights, music, and post-production leads — to report any approval conditions or concerns you have. Let's start with rights.
